description: Return real salary benchmarks for a role, aggregated from crawled GeraJobs listings. For each market (country/currency) you get the sample size and median / 25th / 75th percentile / low / high annual pay — every number traces to real listings. Available roles: software-engineer, data-scientist, product-manager, sales-representative, marketing-manager, customer-support, ux-ui-designer, finance-analyst, project-manager, operations-manager, human-resources, devops-engineer. Optionally filter to one country by ISO code (e.g. "US", "GB"). Omit currency to get all markets for the role.

country_code.description: Optional ISO-3166 country code to filter to one market, e.g. "US", "GB", "CA".

role.description: Role slug or name, e.g. "software-engineer", "Data Scientist", "product-manager".

name: get_salary_benchmark
title: Get a GeraJobs salary benchmark
